cards.headline: The tape: a mixed, rotational tape, 45% of energy names green

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Shale & E&P lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +1.94%; weakest is Shale & E&P at -2.50%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: NXT is the standout at +14.57%
cards.body: Leaders: NXT +14.57%, ENPH +10.68%, RUN +8.69%, ARRY +7.23%, FSLR +5.43%. Laggards: EQNR -5.23%, LNG -3.96%, FLNC -3.93%, APA -3.90%.
